registration.definition_expansion: Inline local definitions; preserve all closed fields; attach exact validated selection.
registration.text_bound: Set every TextWindow.text string maxLength to greatest explicit selected text limit, or zero.
registration.compatibility: Existing episode-fact shorthand expands only the empty selection; use full literal for nonempty selection.

semantic_rules: Use strict finite JSON types; booleans are not integers.
Source/id/artifact witness fields are non-reference strings. Only explicit SourceGrant.source_ref and SequenceGrant.artifact_ref are semantic reference grants.
All request/page/record/field indices correspond exactly to the immutable parent selection. Preserve order and reject duplicate selectors.
TokenRequest.array_ordinal is nonnegative only for secondary_accession and null for all other token fields.
Pointers are RFC6901; record text/EC pointers are relative to the original selected record pointer. No implicit traversal of siblings.
ECValue.ec exact representation must match (digits, n followed by digits, or hyphen) in four dot-separated components; malformed syntax is not representable, not a native type failure.
EvidenceValue.eco exact representation must match ECO followed by colon and seven digits. Other NativeToken fields use their declared non-whitespace token grammar.
Page release/cursor tokens are exactly recorded. next_url additionally requires a recorded validated UniProt next link; do not reconstruct one.
NativeToken exact means state present and nonnull exact source value. Unavailable means null token and original native state preserved.
Integer native state present implies nonnull integer; other native states imply null. observed_sequence_length origin is derived and its pointer is the native sequence value locator.

For TextWindow, absent/null/invalid states have null text/counts/interval and unavailable extent; present empty is empty string with zero length. Present valid text is the exact selected decoded Unicode slice with explicit omitted counts.

TextWindow start=min(offset,N); end=min(offset+limit,N); omitted_prefix=start; omitted_suffix=N-end. offset>N gives offset_past_end; N=0 and offset=0 gives empty_value; start=0 and end=N gives whole_value; otherwise window.
Sequence intervals are exact zero-based half-open aa intervals. Invalid or out-of-range requests produce typed unavailable replies; no clipping or padding.
Feature exact_interval is copied from P and is null unless its original exact-entry sequence association is established; native endpoints are not independently converted.
PageStatus parser_eligible_record_count is publication.page.publishable_record_count; bound_record_count is len(publication.records) and must equal outer result.count.
Record witnesses occur only for actually bound rows; unpublishable/omitted/out-of-range selections remain record replies with unavailable field replies.

Value available/partial replies keep the exact typed object; unavailable means null value with one or more specific failures. Native absent/null/invalid are retained within typed value when the record and field family are inspectable.
Only requested grants are nonnull/available. Unrequested grants have status not_requested and null descriptor; unavailable grants preserve a specific failure.
Page/record issue indices and constrained contents match the original issue arrays. Do not rewrite an outer binding omission as a parser failure.
Every form/field/value relation is authenticated against original saved acquisition and exact selected child facts; JSON shape alone is insufficient.
Forwarding copies exact previously delivered selector/value cells and explicit grants; it never fills unreceived fields from source data.
Closed forms and their private successful-return prefix are immutable. Replaying a historical form performs no current parser/calculator call.

RecordWitness authenticates the original accession relationship internally, but primary/requested accession text is not copied automatically. Explicit token selection delivers primary or secondary accessions.
